latin: Cum dixit Abucaten Auenan animam esse supra tempus, intelligendum est de anima absoluta secundum substantiam, praescindendo ab omni operatione quae competit ei inquantum est anima.
translation: When Abucaten Auenan said that the soul is above time, this is to be understood of the soul considered absolutely according to its substance, prescinding from every operation that belongs to it insofar as it is a soul.
translation_note: 'Abucaten Auenan' is retained untransliterated as Pico's Latin form of the name attached in his source to the Liber de Causis material; not resolved here to a modern identification.
